envelope.description: Integrate bounded paired probes and strict phase exports

body.title: Integrate bounded paired probes and strict phase exports
body.summary: Run at most one labelled control then one restricted phase through CliProvider under existing lane and aggregate 300-second/128K/output limits. Extend optional bounded diagnostic descriptors and owned-file validation. Keep control facts separate from restricted evidence, observe actual process drain and refuse leaks/tampering/stale pins; preserve canonical authority and no-key activation policy.
acceptanceChecks: All provider calls are serial with one shared absolute deadline and inclusive budget; UUID replay and interruptions never retry phases.
Strict export schema validates phase identity/order, manifests, private ownership, file sizes/digests, source/runtime/model/catalog/config/launch pins.
Positive-control output cannot qualify the production launch; only affirmative supported evidence can establish tested exclusions, with missing facts unsupported and leaks failed.
Cross-run checks use actual foreign capability refusals. Overall approval isolation stays unverified without reliable native escalation evidence; flags alone cannot pass.

tests.name: Restricted capability leaks fail and control-phase evidence cannot qualify production
Combined phase deadline budget capture bounds and shared provider lane prevent retries or overlap
Raw phase export rejects tampering foreign roots stale pins and control-to-production promotion
